text: The app is almost ready. If you [[launch|lançar]] the app next week, you will get users fast. But if the app has [[bugs|erros no programa]], people will leave.

a.label: Launch next week
a.result: You launched the app. Many people downloaded it, but some found bugs and left.
a.phrasePt: lançar o app na semana que vem

b.label: Test it for one more month
b.result: You tested the app for a month. It cost money, but the app worked very well.
b.phrase: test the app for one more month
b.phrasePt: testar o app por mais um mês

text: We need more people. If you [[hire|contratar]] five [[engineers|engenheiros]], we will spend all our money in three months.

a.label: Hire five engineers
a.result: The new engineers made the app much better, but the money went down fast.

b.label: Hire only one
b.result: You saved money, but the small team worked slowly.

text: I like your company. If you accept my money, I will [[control|controlar]] half of your company. If you say no, you will grow slowly.

a.label: Accept the money
a.result: You got a lot of money, but Ms. Costa changed some of your ideas.

b.label: Say no
b.result: You kept control of your company, but you grew slowly.

text: Users say the app is [[expensive|caro]]. If you make it free with [[ads|anúncios]], you will get many new users, but we will not make money.

a.label: Make it free, with ads
a.result: Thousands of new users arrived, but the ads did not pay the bills.
a.phrase: make the app free, with ads
a.phrasePt: deixar o app grátis, com anúncios

b.label: Keep the price
b.result: The money kept coming, but some users moved to cheaper apps.

text: If you pay famous [[influencers|influenciadores]], many people will know your app. If you listen to your users, they will tell their friends.

a.label: Pay influencers
a.result: Your app was everywhere on social media for a week. It was very expensive.

b.label: Listen to your users
b.result: Your users felt heard, and some of them told their friends about the app.

text: Someone found a problem in the app's [[security|segurança]]. If you fix it now, you will stop working on new [[features|funcionalidades]] for two weeks.

a.label: Fix it now
a.result: You fixed the problem fast. Users trusted you more.
a.phrasePt: corrigir o problema de segurança na hora

b.label: Fix it later
b.result: Hackers found the problem first. Your company was in the news, and not in a good way.
b.phrasePt: corrigir o problema de segurança depois

text: Our office is too small. If we [[rent|alugar]] a bigger office, we will pay double. If we work from home, we will save money.

a.label: Rent a bigger office
a.result: The new office looked great, and the team was proud of it. The rent was high.

b.label: Work from home
b.result: You saved a lot of money, but the team talked less and made some mistakes.

text: A big company [[copied|copiou]] your idea. If you don't do something, you will lose your users.

a.label: Create a new feature
a.result: Your new feature was a success. The big company could not copy it fast enough.

b.label: Lower the price
b.result: Most users stayed, but you earned less money every month.

text: A famous school wants to use your app. If you say yes, you will get many users, but you will have to give it to them for free.

a.label: Say yes
a.result: Hundreds of students started using your app and talking about it.

b.label: Say no
b.result: You kept your money, but you lost a big opportunity.

text: Your team is very [[tired|cansado]]. If you give them a week off, you will stop for a week. If they keep working, they will make [[mistakes|erros]].

a.label: Give them a week off
a.result: The team came back happy and full of new ideas.
a.phrase: give my team a week off
a.phrasePt: dar uma semana de folga à equipe

b.label: Keep working
b.result: The team made mistakes, and the app stopped working for a day.

text: The bank can [[lend|emprestar]] us money. If we take the [[loan|empréstimo]], we will have more cash now, but we will pay [[interest|juros]] every month.

a.label: Take the loan
a.result: You had money to grow, but paying the bank every month made everyone nervous.

b.label: Say no to the bank
b.result: You used your own money carefully, without debts.

text: An angry user posted a video about your app. If you answer quickly and [[honestly|honestamente]], people will respect you. If you [[ignore|ignorar]] it, the video will go [[viral|viral, espalhar rápido]].

a.label: Answer and give refunds
a.result: You answered with honesty and gave refunds. People respected your company.
a.phrase: answer the angry user and give refunds
a.phrasePt: responder ao usuário e devolver o dinheiro

b.label: Ignore the video
b.result: The video went viral. Many people stopped using your app.

text: People in Argentina want to use your app. If you open an office there, you will get many new users. But if you grow too fast, you will lose control.

a.label: Open an office in Argentina
a.result: Your app became popular in Argentina, but the new office was very expensive.

b.label: Stay in Brazil for now
b.result: You kept your money, but another startup went to Argentina first.

text: Everybody is talking about [[AI|inteligência artificial]]. If you add an AI assistant to the app, users will love it. But if it gives wrong answers, they will [[complain|reclamar]].

a.label: Add an AI assistant
a.result: Users loved the AI assistant, and it was on the news. It cost a lot to build.
a.phrase: add an AI assistant to the app
a.phrasePt: colocar um assistente de IA no app

b.label: Wait and learn more
b.result: You waited, and some users said your app looked old.
b.phrase: wait and learn more about AI
b.phrasePt: esperar e aprender mais sobre IA

text: A company wants to buy your users' [[data|dados]]. If you sell it, you will get a lot of money. If your users [[find out|descobrir]], they will be very angry.

a.label: Sell the data
a.result: You got a lot of money. Two months later, a journalist found out, and users were furious.

b.label: Protect your users
b.result: You said no. Later, users learned about it and trusted your company even more.

text: There is a startup [[competition|competição]] next month. If you enter it, you will stop other work for two weeks. If you win, you will get money and [[fame|fama]].

a.label: Enter the competition
a.result: Preparing for the competition cost time and money. You came second, and many journalists wrote about you.

b.label: Focus on the app
b.result: You worked on the app, but another startup won the competition and got all the attention.

text: You work a lot, but you don't have a [[salary|salário]]. If you pay yourself a salary, you will be happier, but the company will have less money.

a.label: Pay yourself a salary
a.result: You were less stressed, and you made better decisions.

b.label: No salary for now
b.result: You were tired and nervous, and your team noticed it.

text: Black Friday is coming. If we give a 50% [[discount|desconto]], we will sell a lot, but we will [[earn|ganhar]] less on each sale.

a.label: Give 50% off
a.result: You sold a lot, and many new people tried your app.
a.phrase: give a 50% discount on Black Friday
a.phrasePt: dar 50% de desconto na Black Friday

b.label: No discount
b.result: You earned more on each sale, but other apps got the new customers.
b.phrase: keep the normal price on Black Friday
b.phrasePt: manter o preço normal na Black Friday

text: Your [[co-founder|cofundador(a)]] wants to leave the company. If you offer her more money, she will stay. If she leaves, the team will be sad.

a.label: Offer her more money
a.result: She stayed, and the team felt safe again.

b.label: Let her go
b.result: She left. The team was sad, and some users noticed problems in the app.

text: Your [[servers|servidores]] use a lot of [[energy|energia]]. If you change to green energy, it will cost more, but people will like your company more.

a.label: Change to green energy
a.result: It cost more, but young users loved your green company.

b.label: Keep the old servers
b.result: You saved money, but some users said your company didn't care about the planet.

text: We need regular money. If we change to a monthly [[subscription|assinatura]], we will earn money every month, but some users will not want to pay.

a.label: Start a monthly subscription
a.result: Money arrived every month, but some users left because they didn't want to pay.

b.label: Keep the one-time payment
b.result: Users were happy, but the money came in slowly.

text: Some users can't see very well, and the app is hard for them. If you make the app [[accessible|acessível]], you will need two weeks of work.

a.label: Make the app accessible
a.result: Many new users could finally use your app, and they thanked you on social media.

b.label: Leave it for next year
b.result: You saved time, but some users said your company didn't care about them.
b.phrasePt: deixar a acessibilidade para o ano que vem

text: Someone can write 500 [[fake|falsas]] good [[reviews|avaliações]] for your app. If you pay for them, you will look popular. But if people find out, they will stop trusting you.

a.label: Buy fake reviews
a.result: Downloads went up for a while. Then a journalist found out, and people stopped trusting you.

b.label: Ask real users for reviews
b.result: You got fewer reviews, but they were real, and people believed them.
b.phrasePt: pedir avaliações a usuários de verdade

text: Students from IFAL want an [[internship|estágio]] at your company. If you accept them, you will spend time teaching them, but you will find new talent.

a.label: Accept the interns
a.result: The interns learned fast, and one of them had a great idea for the app.

b.label: Say you are too busy
b.result: You kept your time, but the students went to another startup.

text: A famous delivery app wants to work with you. If you accept the [[partnership|parceria]], you will get many users, but they will take 30% of your money.

a.label: Accept the partnership
a.result: Thousands of new users arrived, but you earned less on each sale.

b.label: Stay independent
b.result: You kept all your money, but you grew slowly.

text: Our computers are very old and slow. If we buy new computers, the team will work faster, but they will cost a lot.

a.label: Buy new computers
a.result: The team worked much faster, and the app got better. It was expensive.

b.label: Keep the old computers
b.result: You saved money, but the team lost hours waiting for slow computers.

text: A [[TV show|programa de TV]] wants to [[interview|entrevistar]] you. If you go, many people will know your company. But if you say something wrong, everybody will see it.

a.label: Go on TV
a.result: You stopped work for a week to prepare, but people loved your interview.

b.label: Stay focused on work
b.result: The team worked hard, but nobody heard about your company.

text: Users want help at night too. If you offer help 24 hours a day, users will be happy, but you will need more workers.

a.label: Offer 24-hour support
a.result: Users loved getting help at any time, but the new workers cost a lot.

b.label: Keep office hours only
b.result: You saved money, but some users were angry at night.

text: We made a mistake with our [[taxes|impostos]]. If we pay now, we will lose a lot of money. If we don't pay, the newspapers will talk about it.

a.label: Pay the taxes now
a.result: It hurt, but your company did the right thing, and people respected you for it.

b.label: Wait and see
b.result: You kept the money, but a newspaper wrote that your company doesn't pay its taxes.

text: Older people want to use apps too. If you create a simple version for them, you will find a new [[market|mercado]].

a.label: Create a simple version
a.result: Grandparents all over Brazil started using your app.
a.phrase: create a simple version for older people
a.phrasePt: criar uma versão simples para pessoas mais velhas

b.label: Focus on young users
b.result: Your young users were happy, but you missed a big market.

text: Programmers from other countries are cheaper. If you hire them, you will save money, but [[communication|comunicação]] will be harder.

a.label: Hire programmers abroad
a.result: You saved money, but there were many problems because of communication.

b.label: Hire people from your city
b.result: It cost more, but your city was proud of your company.

text: Our [[costs|custos]] went up. If we [[raise|aumentar]] the price, we will keep making money, but some users will leave.

a.label: Raise the price
a.result: Your money was safe, but many users moved to other apps.

b.label: Keep the price the same
b.result: You earned less, but your users stayed with you and thanked you.

text: Many users live in places with bad internet. If you create an [[offline|sem internet]] mode, they will use the app anywhere. But it will take a month of work.

a.label: Create an offline mode
a.result: It took a month, but users in small towns loved the app and told their friends.

b.label: Keep it online only
b.result: You saved time, but many users in small towns stopped using the app.

text: Users hate the new [[design|visual do app]]. If you go back to the old design, you will lose two months of work. If you keep the new one, some users will leave.

a.label: Go back to the old design
a.result: You lost two months of work, but users were happy again.
a.phrase: go back to the old design

b.label: Keep the new design
b.result: You saved time, but many users wrote angry comments, and some of them left.

text: Your biggest [[client|cliente]] wants a special feature only for them. If you build it, they will pay you a lot. But your other users will wait for two months.

a.label: Build it for the client
a.result: The client paid very well, but your other users waited, and some of them complained.
a.phrase: build a special feature for my biggest client
a.phrasePt: criar uma funcionalidade só para o maior cliente

b.label: Put all users first
b.result: The client paid less, but all your users got new features on time.
b.phrasePt: colocar todos os usuários em primeiro lugar

text: The programs we use are expensive. If we use [[pirated|piratas]] copies, we will save money. But if someone finds out, we will pay a big [[fine|multa]].

a.label: Use pirated copies
a.result: You saved money for a few months. Then an old worker told a journalist, and people stopped trusting your company.

b.label: Pay for the programs
b.result: It was expensive, but big clients trusted your company because everything was legal.

text: We don't have a [[backup|cópia de segurança]] of our users' files. If we pay for a backup, it will cost a little money every month. But if the system breaks, we will lose everything.

a.label: Pay for a backup
a.result: It cost a little money every month. When a server broke in June, nobody lost anything, and users trusted you more.
a.phrasePt: pagar por uma cópia de segurança

b.label: Save the money
b.result: You saved money. Then the system broke one night, and many users lost their files.

text: This month is hard. If we pay our [[suppliers|fornecedores]] late, we will have more money now. But they will not want to work with us again.

a.label: Pay them late
a.result: You had money for the month, but two suppliers stopped working with you.

b.label: Pay on time
b.result: Money was short that month, but your suppliers trusted you and gave you better prices later.

text: A [[soft drink|refrigerante]] company wants to put its logo in your app. If you accept, you will get a lot of money. But many of your users are teenagers, and parents will not like it.

a.label: Accept the deal
a.result: The money helped a lot, but many parents complained on social media.
a.phrase: accept the soft drink company's money
a.phrasePt: aceitar o dinheiro da empresa de refrigerante

b.label: Say no to the deal
b.result: You lost the money, but parents and schools liked your choice.
b.phrase: say no to the soft drink company
b.phrasePt: dizer não à empresa de refrigerante

text: I can put more money in your company. But if you accept it, you will have to [[fire|demitir]] ten people. If you say no, you will keep your team.

a.label: Accept and fire ten people
a.result: You got the money, but the team was sad and afraid. Two of your best engineers left too.
a.phrase: accept the money and fire ten people
a.phrasePt: aceitar o dinheiro e demitir dez pessoas

b.label: Keep the team
b.result: Money was short, but your team worked harder than ever for you.

text: A small [[competitor|concorrente]] is for sale. If you buy it, you will get all its users. But it will be expensive, and you will have to fix its old app.

a.label: Buy the competitor
a.result: Its users came to your app. Fixing the old app was hard and very expensive.

b.label: Grow on your own
b.result: You saved your money, but a bigger company bought your competitor.

text: Your fans want to help. If you start a [[crowdfunding|vaquinha on-line]] campaign, they will give you money. But if the [[rewards|recompensas]] arrive late, they will be angry.

a.label: Start the campaign
a.result: Two thousand fans gave you money, but the rewards arrived late, and some fans complained.

b.label: Find money in other ways
b.result: You didn't get extra money, but you never made promises that you couldn't keep.
b.phrase: look for money in other ways
